Folio Roadmap

Development board

Two products with independent release tracks: documentation for people and agents, plus repository-native coordination for coding harnesses.

Folio Docs

Source analysis, theming, the plugin platform, more languages, migrations, the API portal, and the beta. Everything that turns a repository into a published site.

v0.1Shipped

Foundation

Source analysis

The proof of concept is Python: source in, documented site out.

  • One command sets the project up
  • Reads your source, never runs it
  • API reference and your guides in one site
  • Types and symbols link to their pages
  • Edit a docstring, see the page
  • A component library and full-text search
  • llms.txt from day one
v0.2Shipped

Theming

Visual ownership

Own the look at any depth, then ship it anywhere static files go.

  • Presets, shareable packages, or your own template
  • Readers retheme the site from the site
  • A preview site per pull request
  • Social preview images
v0.3In progress

Plugin Platform

One platform

Built-in and project extensions share one plugin contract, and this site runs on it.

  • Plugins ship pages, components, and commands
  • Your own React components in any page
  • Every project ships its authoring contract
  • Every page gets a portable Markdown mirror
  • Roadmap, landing, and OpenAPI integrations
  • A briefing for your coding agent
v0.4Up next

More Languages

Reach

New languages arrive as parsers, not new toolchains, so adding one never means starting over.

  • Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go, C#, and Java in one site
  • One search, one llms.txt, every language
  • References that cross languages
  • Type information inline in examples
  • A public contract for adding a language
  • Docs for every version of your library
  • Sites in your readers' languages
  • A native fast path in Rust for big repos
v0.5Up next

Migrations

Adoption

Bring your existing docs over in one command, with an honest report of what didn't convert.

  • One-command import from MkDocs, Mintlify, and Read the Docs
  • Sphinx cross-links carry over
  • A theme preset that feels familiar
  • Redirects for every moved page
  • One site across products and repos
v0.6Later

API Portal

API workflow

The API portal teams expect: changelogs from real changes, and examples that cannot lie.

  • Field-level API components
  • A page per endpoint
  • Builds fail on breaking changes
  • Try requests on the page
  • SDK examples verified against the code
  • Event APIs too
v0.7Up next

Public Beta

Distribution

A coordinated beta with a settled first run, an installable release, and clear stability boundaries.

  • folio score — how agent-ready any docs site is
  • Starter templates
  • A plugin catalog outsiders can publish into
  • Live plugin demos with their source

Folio for Agents

A board of Markdown files in git, session conclusions that outlive a session, and the artifacts a coding tool reads and writes through ordinary commits.

v0.1In progress

Repository Board

Shared work state

Agents and humans operate one reviewable board made of Markdown files in git.

  • One permanent file per card
  • Acceptance criteria, trails, comments, and artifacts stay with the work
  • Validated commands make narrow, reviewable edits
  • A repository-owned protocol teaches every coding harness the same workflow
  • An optional browser canvas publishes the board and attached artifacts
v0.2Up next

Session Memory

Durable context

A useful agent session leaves a concise conclusion that the next session can find and reuse.

  • Session conclusions attach to the card they moved
  • Decisions and reusable snippets remain readable in the repository
  • Teams choose which artifacts become published pages
  • Context can be condensed without losing confirmed decisions
v0.3Up next

Project Coordination

Repository operations

The board becomes a dependable projection of releases, dependencies, and active ownership.

  • Roadmap phases project from product-owned board milestones
  • Agents claim work without hiding ownership from humans
  • Issue and CI state reconcile with the repository board
  • Quality gates fail before invalid work state is published
v0.4Later

Harness Network

Shared ecosystem

Teams share useful agent workflows and context contracts without centralizing their repository state.

  • Discover reusable skills and operating protocols
  • Publish portable context contracts between repositories
  • Keep identity, work state, and permissions under each repository's control
